title: Detaching Emotionally From 2024
description:
The job search has too many places for emotional frustration. This year I’m approaching things with a “welp” attitude and not caring about things outside my control like ghosting, bad job postings and bad application forms. #jobseeker #jobseekers #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobapplication #jobapplicationtips
